n. the property of being an amount by which something is less than expected or required
n. a deficiency or failure in neurological or mental functioning
n. (sports) the score by which a team or individual is losing
n. an excess of liabilities over assets (usually over a certain period)
entry.zh:
n. 赤字, 不足额
[医] 短缺

entry.head: bathroom
entry.definition: n. a room (as in a residence) containing a bathtub or shower and usually a washbasin and toilet

entry.head: frequency
entry.definition:
n. the number of occurrences within a given time period
n. the ratio of the number of observations in a statistical category to the total number of observations
n. the number of observations in a given statistical category
entry.zh:
n. 频率, 频数
[计] 频率
